jobs.title: Manager Product Research & GTM, Program Adoption
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Work Timings - Monday to Friday;  
Timings- 1 Noon to 10 PM (Day Shift)  
We're looking for exceptional talent to join Amazon's Product Acceleration Team (PAT), a specialized unit that sits at the intersection of product development, seller experience, and Seller research. PAT plays a crucial role in fast-tracking product improvements through direct seller engagement, rapid research execution, and actionable insights generation.  
  
We’re looking for an enthusiastic user experience researcher to explore the world of building amazon products and generate insights that connect product experiences to business needs. Your focus will cover all aspects of customer research, from learning more about our customers types to uncovering problems that need to be solved to usability testing new designs. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand the decisions that need to be made and then conduct research projects to gather the correct data to help make those decisions.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Key job responsibilities  

* Plan and execute quantitative and qualitative research studies to shape Product roadmap. That may include large-scale surveys, usability testing, or conducting interviews. Select the right methodology, while demonstrating good judgement in making trade-offs between speed and rigor.

  

* Understand business needs and develop a product marketing strategy and roadmap in partnership with business and product stakeholders.

  

* Deliver findings that will directly address the business need, create actionable recommendations, and work with stakeholders to shape product roadmaps based on data.

  

* Generate insights from business analytics, as well as customer feedback. Synthesize and triangulate data from various sources to deliver insights to the business. Know when enough data has been collected to answer the question.

  

* Generate ideas on new or more efficient ways to drive product marketing at scale

  

* Partner closely with product and business teams on the full product lifecycle (customer research, ideation, proposal, launch and post-launch analysis). Develop relationships and processes to connect decision-makers to customer needs.

  

* Lead an extended team of Research Managers and Marketing managers to meet overall goals

  

* Develop weekly metrics to track critical inputs and outputs and report out in weekly business reviews

  
About the team  
Seller Enablement Growth (SEG) specializes in driving seller adoption of new features and programs across Amazon's marketplace, working closely with product teams to gather Voice of Seller feedback, accelerate feature launches, and ensure seller success through strategic engagement and educational initiatives.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
* Experience managing teams
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional email and push marketing campaigns (including automated flows) from concept to completion
* Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
* Experience building, executing and scaling cross-functional marketing programs
* Experience working with multiple stakeholders at various levels and in different locales to drive alignment

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements

- Experience with CRM tools and systems that can be leveraged to drive customer engagement - including but not limited to Adobe, Salesforce, Unica, Marketo, Exact Target, Braze, etc.  

* Experience building, executing and scaling digital programmatic campaigns from concept to completion

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager- SCM/Ecommerce
jobs.description:
As a Product Manager at Oracle NetSuite, you will help shape and deliver supply chain, Mobile, and Warehouse Management solutions from discovery through release. You will work closely with engineering, design, quality assurance, support, and go-to-market teams to solve customer problems and deliver products on schedule and within budget.

You will define product strategy, requirements, and priorities using customer feedback, business needs, and product insights. A key part of the role is identifying where GenAI and intelligent automation can simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, and improve the user experience. You will translate these opportunities into clear requirements and measurable outcomes, considering accuracy, data privacy, and user control.

Your responsibilities will include aligning teams on product decisions, reviewing designs and documentation, managing dependencies, and supporting successful releases. You will also use AI tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, documentation, and test planning, while applying sound judgment to their outputs.

This role requires independent judgment, strong communication, and the ability to manage complex priorities. You may lead cross-functional initiatives and mentor junior colleagues. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience, is required.

  

Responsbilities:

* Collaborate with Manufacturers and Wholesale Distributors to build the next generation of supply chain solution
* Proactively define and drive the creation of new features that customers love
* Identify opportunities to use GenAI and intelligent automation to simplify workflows, improve decisions, and reduce manual effort
* Create use cases, user stories, and detailed product requirements document that clearly articulate desired product functionality
* Collaborate with Development, QA, Doc, and UI to deliver great products and tools for both the customers as well as developers
* Build a strong understanding of the market, competitive landscape, and emerging AI capabilities relevant to supply chain operations
* Manage the product backlog and prioritize product enhancements, customer and partner requests by making smart, decisive tradeoffs using data-driven analysis and sound judgment
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Professional Services and Support to successfully rollout our products and ensure a great end-to-end customer experience
Evaluate AI-enabled features for usefulness, accuracy, reliability, and appropriate user control  

Qualifications/Skills:

* Must be a self-motivated team player
* Ability to gather complex customer requirements and translate requirements into a detail plan for execution
* Strong functional knowledge in at least two areas: Inventory, Warehouse Management, Fulfillment, Shipping, or Outbound Order Processing
* Preferably 5+ years of product management experience, with experience delivering applications through at least two product releases
* Practical experience with GenAI or AI-related projects is a plus, particularly in enterprise applications, workflow automation, or decision support
* Ability to identify meaningful AI use cases and define how their value and quality will be measured.
B.Tech or Bachelor of Engineering required. MBA a plus  

Oracle NetSuite is investing in GenAI and AI-powered capabilities to improve supply chain execution, decision-making, and productivity. In this role, you will help shape intelligent workflows, predictive insights, automated configuration, and GenAI-enabled experiences across Mobile and WMS, making everyday work simpler and more effective for customers.

OneMart is a growing building materials company serving builders, developers, architects, contractors and individual customers through its multiple showrooms. Our product portfolio includes tiles, sanitaryware, CP fittings, pipes, aluminium windows, quartz, marble, glass and related building solutions.

The candidate will be responsible for developing and executing marketing strategies, strengthening brand visibility, building relationships with industry stakeholders and generating qualified business leads.

* Develop and implement annual, quarterly and monthly marketing plans aligned with business objectives.
* Plan and execute marketing campaigns for OneMart's product categories and showrooms.

* Develop marketing strategies for project sales, retail sales and showroom promotions.
* Lead and manage the marketing team, including field marketing executives.
* Establish relationships with architects, builders, developers, contractors and other key industry influencers.

* Coordinate with the sales and business development teams to generate and convert qualified leads.
* Manage marketing budgets, campaign expenditure and return-on-investment tracking.
* Work with the digital marketing team on social media campaigns, content, promotions and brand communication.
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis and customer feedback assessments.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or a related discipline; MBA Marketing preferred.

* Demonstrated ability to plan and execute marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of Hyderabad's construction and real estate ecosystem.
* Experience in managing teams, events, budgets and marketing activities.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Product Lead – Skills**

1. Strong domain and business knowledge in relevant product, operations, and technology areas.

2. Experience working with agile product delivery teams across multiple squads.

3. Strong knowledge of backlog management, prioritization, release planning, and dependency management.

4. Ability to assess business value, urgency, risks, capacity constraints, and delivery trade-offs.

5. Experience using Jira, ESM, dashboards, and reporting tools for backlog and delivery visibility.

6. Strong stakeholder management skills across Product, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, SMEs, and business teams.

7. Ability to translate product strategy and business needs into actionable priorities for squads.

8. Strong communication, influencing, and problem-solving skills.

9. Experience coaching or mentoring Product Owners, Business Analysts, or similar roles.

10. Understanding of functional requirements, non-functional requirements, technical debt, production support, and continuous improvement.

11. Ability to work effectively in a complex environment with high request volumes and competing priorities.

12. Understanding of agile principles, product operating models, and governance practices.

**Product Lead – Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Act as the domain-level product lead for a defined area, such as Core, Print, or Voting/Tabulation/Edit Load.

2. Translate Product Manager strategy, roadmap priorities, and business objectives into clear direction for Product Owners and squads.

3. Support prioritization and sequencing of work across squads, including discretionary initiatives, run/OCC work, lite requests, regulatory work, production support, and technical debt.

4. Review incoming requests for business value, urgency, timelines, dependencies, impacted squads, capacity implications, and governance needs.

5. Ensure requests are categorized and prioritized using agreed criteria, such as Critical, High, Medium, and Low.

6. Work with Product Owners to align squad backlogs with domain priorities, roadmap commitments, and available capacity.

7. Guide Product Owners on backlog quality, requirement readiness, prioritization, stakeholder communication, and dependency management.

8. Participate in key business and refinement discussions for complex, high-priority, cross-squad, or high-risk initiatives.

9. Ensure appropriate SME involvement for discovery, technical clarification, spikes, and requirement validation.

10.Coordinate with Delivery Managers, Engineering leaders, QA leads, SMEs, and Scrum Masters on delivery constraints, dependencies, and sequencing impacts.

11. Maintain visibility into domain-level capacity, delivery risks, blockers, resource constraints, and impacts to roadmap commitments.

12. Identify and escalate priority conflicts, major trade-offs, cross-squad dependencies, and delivery risks to the Product Manager when needed.

13. Support domain intake reviews, backlog reviews, prioritization discussions, and governance preparation.

14. Provide regular domain-level updates on priorities, progress, risks, capacity, dependencies, and milestone impacts.

15. Coach and support Product Owners; where needed, directly perform Product Owner responsibilities for specific initiatives, including gathering requirements, creating/refining stories, managing backlog items, and supporting delivery through completion.

We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

* To acquire, maintain relationships and increase product penetration within corporates by engaging with Key Influencers, by leading a team of 14-15 Relationship Managers to drive EBS, Credit Cards, Personal Loans, Any time Credit and Top UP Medical Health Insurance ( BAGIC)

* To ensure the team engages with existing EBS customers to increase penetration across various digital platforms (eg Mobile X & PIB), IVR Card activations and salary credits.
* Drive open market business (Credit Cards, Personal Loans etc) through activities/deployments, promotions & lead based calling.
* Develop a robust, diligent and compliant sales channel
* To liaise with product and support teams on a constant basis to enhance customer offerings and service delivery
* To adhere to all regulatory guidelines and handle complaints effectively.
* Deliver fair outcomes for our customers and ensure own conduct maintains the orderly and transparent operation of financial markets

**Key activities to be driven**

jobs.title: Product Manager (GenAI & Enterprise Software)
jobs.description:
Anyone can build a GenAI demo in a weekend. Making it work for real users, inside enterprise constraints, on a real deadline and budget, is where products are won. As our Product Manager for GenAI and Enterprise Software, that’s your job.
  
  
At Techdome, we build AI-first products for enterprise clients in FinTech, Healthcare, E-commerce, EdTech, Logistics, and SaaS. Our engineers, designers, and AI specialists are excellent. We need a PM who turns that talent into shipped products: someone who catches the unclear requirement, the dropped handoff, and the unspoken risk before they become delays.
  
  
**The Role in One Line**
You own each product from the first client conversation to launch and beyond: scope, schedule, budget, risk, and the client relationship.
  
  
**What You’ll Work On**
Your portfolio will blend two worlds. On the GenAI side: LLM-powered applications, RAG systems, conversational assistants, autonomous AI agents, and end-to-end workflow automation. On the enterprise side: scalable software platforms with integrations, security, and compliance requirements to match. Every product has to launch on time, stay within budget, and move the metrics our clients care about.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Shape the product: Turn client vision into clear scope, milestones, timelines, and budgets that are ambitious but grounded in technical reality.
* Keep teams in sync: Coordinate UI/UX, frontend, backend, mobile, QA, DevOps, and business analysts so handoffs are clean and nothing is left to assumption.
* Take GenAI from demo to production: Work with ML engineers to make prototypes reliable, scalable, and safe, with attention to accuracy, latency, evaluation, and cost per query.
* Bridge GenAI and enterprise needs: Fit AI features into client systems through APIs and integrations, while meeting enterprise expectations for security, data privacy, and uptime.
* Become fluent in the client’s world: Learn their industry, regulations, and compliance needs, and convert them into requirements the team can build without guesswork.
* Lead people and partners: Plan team capacity, manage third-party vendors (including LLM and cloud providers), and hold everyone to clear commitments.
* Raise risks early: Run structured change control and flag delivery, technical, and AI-specific risks (privacy, bias, hallucinations, prompt injection, runaway costs) while they’re still cheap to fix.
* Report honestly: Track progress in JIRA or Azure DevOps and give clients and leadership clear, no-surprise updates.
* Work smarter with AI: Use AI tools to speed up documentation, planning, tracking, and reporting.

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: You learn our delivery process, meet the team, and get up to speed on active client projects.
* By 60 days: You independently lead at least one project, owning the plan, the risks, and the client relationship.
* By 90 days: You’ve delivered a key milestone, improved how we run projects, and earned the trust of your team and clients.

**What You Bring**
**Must have**

* 3+ years as a Product Manager delivering complex enterprise software on time and within budget
* Hands-on GenAI experience, ideally having shipped at least one LLM, RAG, or agent-based product, with a clear grasp of the AI lifecycle and its risks

**Description**
The Sr. Product Manager-Tech on the DSP-DA LifeCycle Management (DALCM) team owns the end-to-end product strategy and execution for the critical milestones in the Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Delivery Associate (DA) lifecycle, including onboarding, off-boarding, qualifications management, and status management across Amazon's global transportation network. The DSP program is the backbone of Amazon's last-mile delivery network, operating in 22 countries with over 4,400 DSPs and 390,000+ Delivery Associates.
  
  
This role is responsible for customer experiences with considerable complexity, managing a unified data platform that serves as the single source of truth for associate information. This includes ownership of multiple concurrent product workstreams — DSP DA onboarding/off-boarding workflow, DSP onboarding/off-boarding experience, employment classification models, qualifications management, and DA data/metadata services — each requiring distinct technical approaches and stakeholder alignment. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech is responsible for driving strategic goals that span multi-million dollar cost savings, DSP satisfaction (CSAT), and DA sentiment — influencing the DA experience from the very first interaction with Amazon's systems. You will own the financial entitlement for your product area and be accountable for measurable improvements in onboarding speed, compliance automation, and operational efficiency for DSPs worldwide.
  
  
We are in the early stages of a multi-year initiative to overhaul much of the DA lifecycle experience from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to invent and simplify at scale — redesigning foundational systems and workflows that touch hundreds of thousands of drivers globally. The role comes with significant investment backing and outsized influence in shaping what the next-generation experience looks like.
  
  
This is a global role requiring cross-regional coordination across all regions where the DSP program is established or will be established, each with distinct compliance requirements, legal frameworks, hiring models, and payment structures. The role requires distinguishing between one-way and two-way door decisions to drive rapid experimentation where possible while ensuring appropriate rigor for irreversible choices. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech serves as Voice of the Customer by generalizing requirements from diverse DSP DA personas across regions and use cases — working backward from their needs to reduce friction and time spent in onboarding and offboarding phases. Through direct engagement with DSPs, analysis of support tickets, and monitoring of operational health post-launch, the Sr. Product Manager-Tech gains insight that distinguishes between surface-level requests and underlying problems that truly matter. The Sr. Product Manager-Tech regularly drives product discussions with senior managers and Directors, producing clear documentation and contributing to OP1/OP2 planning cycles.
  
  
We are seeking a PM with expertise and high judgment to determine the right goals, design long-term solutions, and take the lead on initiatives independently while seeking direction when needed. This role operates in a space where problems, opportunities, and strategy are not always clearly defined, and the right candidate will thrive in that ambiguity.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
  
  
With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different - in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
  
  
Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
  
  
Alter Domus Intelligence (ADI) is our next-generation, AI-native platform: a single, cross-asset front end for our clients and their investors that replaces fragmented legacy portals with one coherent, trusted experience. ADI’s first use cases go live in October 2026, and the platform is now building toward a much broader product vision across the entire client and investor journey.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own two foundational layers of ADI: the ADI Platform — the technical and product foundation on which every ADI squad builds — and the Global Master Data Management (GMDM) / Entity Master capability, which is the single mastered entity layer that every squad in the programme depends on.
  
  
ADI is a micro front-end (MFE) architecture: a common shell (authentication, navigation, notifications, search, component library, home and admin pages) into which independent squads — Investor, Payments, Fund of Funds, Reporting and others — plug their surfaces. GMDM sits beneath all of them: it is the single canonical source of truth for Clients, Investors, Funds, Vendors and related parties across the entire enterprise — the foundation without which no squad can correctly identify, secure, or display its data.
  
  
You are not building features for end users directly — you are building the products that enable every other product team. Your customers are internal squads and their engineers, and your success is measured by their velocity, consistency, and ability to ship. At the same time, you own capabilities that are end-user facing and mission-critical: authentication and access control, the home experience, notifications, universal search, the shared component library, and the Entity Master admin experience. You must hold both platforms to the same rigour as any customer-facing product — with performance, availability, security, data quality and developer experience treated as first-class requirements.
  
  
You will work hands-on: authoring executable PRDs, building the first prototypes yourself, and partnering tightly with engineering, architecture, and the other product managers across the ADI programme.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
Platform vision, strategy & roadmap
  
  

* Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for the ADI Platform — the MFE shell, authentication and authorisation layer, shared component library, notifications engine, universal search, and all cross-cutting platform capabilities.
* Define and maintain a clear boundary between what the Platform owns and what belongs to feature squads — resolving ambiguity at pace and with authority, so no squad is ever blocked by an unclear ownership question.
* Prioritise the platform backlog against squad-enablement velocity, non-functional requirements, technical debt, and programme-level delivery commitments.
* Act as the product authority for the platform, making the decisions that trade off between feature-squad needs and platform coherence.

Developer experience & internal product
  
  

* Treat the other ADI squads as your primary customers — understand their dependency needs, pain points and roadmap commitments, and design the platform to enable them rather than constrain them.
* Own the golden-path developer experience: template projects, the shared NPM component library (Photon), CI/CD patterns, MFE composition standards, and deployment infrastructure — ensuring every squad has a well-lit path to building and shipping.
* Establish and govern the standards and contracts between the platform and squad microsites — import maps, API standards, component versioning, and token enrichment — so the platform can evolve without breaking consumers.
* Work alongside the other product managers to help their teams onboard to, and correctly consume, platform capabilities.

Authentication, authorisation & multi-tenancy
  
  

* Own the end-to-end authentication and authorisation product: integration with CIAM and GSP, role-based access control (RBAC), UI component-level authorisation patterns, token enrichment, and the multi-tenancy and client-isolation model.
* Define the access model clearly — who can see what, in which context, for which client or fund — and ensure it is implemented consistently across every squad’s surface.
* Own org context switching, user account management (/account), and the admin experience (/admin).

Core platform experiences
  
  

* Own the ADI home page — including the customisable widget framework (calendar views, user-based preferences) — and ensure it serves as a coherent, high-value landing experience for all user personas.
* Own universal search across ADI — defining scope, relevance, and the integration model with squad-specific content — in alignment with the AI-unified search strategy.
* Own the notifications engine — defining the notification taxonomy, routing logic, SLA and priority model, and the interfaces through which feature squads publish notifications — and partner with the squads (e.g. Fund of Funds, Payments) who consume it.
* Own the cross-team calendar service, the feature-flagging framework, and user-analytics instrumentation.

We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
The Data Analyst II works with Client Services staff to process data changes upon request. The Data Analyst II is also responsible for delivering data transfers when needed. The Data Analyst II shows high attention to detail to ensure that data updates they conduct, as well as data transfers they output and deliver to our clients, are of the utmost quality.
  
  
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES – Function
  
  

* Demonstrates extreme attention to detail and organization in all aspects of work.
* Responsible for executing data changes per request, either through backend database scripts or with the use of validated in-house Data Solution Tools.
* Creates and executes Data Change Guides (DCGs) and determines corresponding risk/impact assessments.
* Creates DTS packages for imports into study databases.
* Writes and executes SQL queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* May be called upon to execute SAS queries against MS SQL Database to extract data for data transfers and reports.
* Delivers client-requested database transfer datasets upon request.
* Participates in meetings with appropriate Client Services and Technical Delivery team members as it relates to study implementation and maintenance.
* Follows Signant Health Standard Operating Procedures for data change management, data transfer verification, and risk/impact assessment documentation.
* Creates stored procedures to manipulate data for data-driven changes to IXR system functionality if needed.
* Monitors data collected across multiple databases when required.
* May be called upon to verify data change requests.
* May be called upon to verify content of client-requested database transfer datasets per approved Data Transfer specifications.
* Some data entry of data change requests may be required.
* Technical support after-hours, on-call time is required at set intervals.
* Participates in special data-related projects as needed.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES
  
  
**Essential:**  

* 2–4 years of experience working in a data-driven environment.
* In-depth working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), as well as Microsoft Windows and the suite of Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience with standard data mining and data presentation techniques.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced work environment with minimal direct supervision.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to effectively document procedures, processes, and results.
* Excellent verbal communication skills, as interaction with team members occurs daily.
* Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines and multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
* Very strong skills with Microsoft Office applications.
* Comfortable working with business users and technical teams.
* Ability to create and execute SQL queries is required.

**Desirable:**  

* Familiarity with the C# programming language is a plus.
* Working knowledge of Visual Basic is a plus.
* Familiarity with GCP and 21 CFR Part 11 is a plus.

At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
If you are looking for purpose-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.

jobs.title: IT&D Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Information Technology & Digital
  
  
In IT and D, you'll be a force for good, whether you're championing cyber security, defining how we harness the power of technology to improve our business, or working with data to guide the innovation of consumer loved products. Working globally across functions, you'll own your projects and process from start to finish, with the influence and visibility to achieve what needs to be done. And if you're willing to bring your ideas to the table, you'll get the support and investment to make them happen. Your potential will never be wasted. You'll get the space and support to take your development to the next level. Every day, there will be opportunities to learn from peers and leaders through working on exciting, varied projects with real impact. And because our work spans so many different businesses, from Research and Product Development to Sales, you'll keep learning exciting new approaches.
  
  
**About The Role**
Explore the forefront of purposeful technology and innovation as an IT & D Business Analyst at Reckitt. Within our collaborative IT & Digital team, every day is a chance to create meaningful impact. Here, you'll be ensuring excellence across a global network that's dedicated to a cleaner, healthier world. If you possess a blend of strategic thinking and technical expertise, and you're ready to transform business needs into cutting-edge IT & D solutions, we would love to hear from you. Be the catalyst for change in a company committed to making a difference.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Analyse business needs, translating them into precise IT & D solutions, ensuring alignment with our strategic vision.
* Engage in data analysis, user research, and other studies to bolster product development and enhancements.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders such as product managers, data scientists, and engineers to deliver exemplary products.
* Navigate complex data landscapes, interpreting and defining specifications for technological processes.
* Act as a steward of change, facilitating communication between technical teams and business users for clarity and successful solution implementation.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Proficient in analysing requirements and translating business processes into clear specifications.
* Familiar with manufacturing processes and a deep understanding of IT systems, cybersecurity, and data analytics.
* Well-versed in project and programme management, design thinking, and IT service management.
* Skilled in change management practises with a focus on stakeholder relationship management and user adoption.
* Strong communication skills, capable of advising and guiding diverse teams and stakeholders.

The skills for success
  
  
Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

jobs.description:

Product Mgmt.

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

**Description**
Selection quality and health are key to Amazon Now’s growth and differentiation. As the business expands, selection decisions need to be supported by systems that can sense demand, guide assortment actions, enable publishing, improve seller execution, and monitor quality at scale.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the Selection Quality, Health and Seller tools System for Amazon Now. This product will help category teams identify demand-backed selection opportunities, understand what selection is available across the broader network, move approved selection through publishing workflows, and monitor whether live selection remains healthy for customers.
  
  
The PM will own product strategy, roadmap, success metrics, and adoption mechanisms across selection intelligence, recommendation systems, publishing tools, seller experience, and live selection monitoring.

jobs.description:
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent, technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality.
  
  
We are looking for a Product Manager to partner with a local in-person engineering team in Bengaluru focused on music distribution. Distribution is the vital link between music creation and a fan’s headphones, ensuring our music reaches platforms like Spotify and YouTube globally while protecting the complex rights that ensure our artists get paid. You will be a "user-first" thinker who is responsible for a portfolio of features and products, navigating the high-stakes world of global rights, supply chain automation, and high-scale digital delivery.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Continuous Discovery: Build deep empathy for our labels, operations teams, and global partners by maintaining a constant dialogue with them. Uncover their underlying pain points, ensuring that every solution we build truly solves their problems and makes their daily workflows more seamless.
* Strategy & Roadmap: Define and communicate the long-term vision and roadmap for your products, ensuring they align with WMG’s broader tech strategy.
* Product Trio Collaboration: Work in a "Product Trio" alongside Engineering and Design to solve complex problems, resolving trade-offs and tackling risks.
* Execution & Ownership: Serve as the primary author of PRDs and the "executor-in-chief" for your projects, driving development from ideation through technical delivery.
* Launch & Impact: Develop comprehensive go-to-market strategies, including product positioning, internal messaging, and launch plans. You don't just "ship" code; you ensure the organization is ready to adopt it to achieve maximum impact.
* Analytical Optimization: Continuously monitor product performance metrics, user feedback, and market trends. Use this data to make informed prioritization decisions, identify areas for improvement, and manage technical debt to optimize the product over its entire lifecycle.

**Who You Are**

* Experienced: You have at least 5 years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to the music business or other digital media.
* Technical & Business Savvy: You can discuss system architecture with engineers and business constraints with executives, mitigating Value, Usability, Feasibility, and Business Viability risks upfront.
* A Master Storyteller: You own the "Why" and can easily adjust your communication style for different audiences, from developers to more senior stakeholders.
* Biased to Action: You have a proven ability to unstick a team, make difficult prioritization decisions, and navigate the ambiguity of a global business.
* Humble Leader: You have strong opinions, held weakly; you are quick to share credit with your team and accept responsibility when things don’t go as planned.
* Mission-Driven: You are a music fan motivated by the fact that your work directly impacts an artist’s ability to grow their career and get paid.

jobs.description:
**About GeneralMind**

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

**About the role**

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.

You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.

This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.

**What You'll Do**

* Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.
* Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.
* Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.
* Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.
* Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.
* Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.
* Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong product thinking and systems intuition.
* Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.
* Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.
* A strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving startup environments.
* Fluency in English.
* Excitement about AI-native products and autonomous systems.

jobs.description:
As a Product Owner, you are responsible for maximizing the value of the product and the work of the Delivery Team by clearly expressing Product Backlog items. You are responsible for ordering the items to best achieve goals and missions. You will calculate, measure and track business value, as well as optimize the value of the work the Development Team performs ensuring that the Product Backlog is visible, transparent, and clear to all. This will show what the Delivery Team will work on next. You will ensure the Delivery Team understands items in the Product Backlog to the level needed.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and explicitly communicate the Product Goal
* Manage and maintain a transparent product backlog, re-evaluate customer product needs and continually balance priorities of the product across maintenance and strategic initiatives
* Review product features as they are developed, providing feedback and guidance.
* Participate as a member of the Agile Team, attend Scrum Events, and is responsible for defining epics and stories including Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done
* Interacts with a diverse set of stakeholders, including Senior Management, business and technology teams, customers, suppliers, and external partners
* Represent the needs of many stakeholders in the Product Backlog and work directly with delivery teams as the voice of the customer
* Drive cohesion across the team but focus efforts on the desired features, while ensuring that each team member is able to contribute to the product’s goals
* Provide clear direction and flexibility when priorities change based on user needs and requirements
* Participate in Agile SDLC activities, including planning, refinement, stand-ups and retrospectives. Provide support to manage iteration planning and refinement of user stories. Spotlight inter-dependencies among cross-product development teams to ensure seamless delivery
* Collaborate with other POs, and Product Executives to ensure the vision of the product is being met and that the product backlog is aligned with the program backlog
* Coordinate closely with the Product Executive to ensure alignment with the Outcome Based Product Roadmap and Objectives and Key Results (OKRs)
* Serve as a thought leader for a specific business and technology team and assists other leaders with the delegation of work assignments

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced digital product professional to lead the strategy, development, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of customer-facing mobile applications. The role requires strong product ownership, technical understanding, stakeholder management, and experience managing complex digital platforms throughout their lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will combine customer experience expertise with technical product knowledge to drive product adoption, operational excellence, and measurable business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

**Product Strategy and Ownership**

* Define and manage product vision, roadmaps, feature priorities, and business outcomes for mobile applications.
* Translate business objectives and customer needs into product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and measurable deliverables.
* Manage product backlogs, sprint planning, release schedules, dependencies, and delivery priorities.
* Lead product discovery, refinement, demonstrations, reviews, and stakeholder alignment.
* Oversee user acceptance testing, business readiness, release approvals, and post-launch improvements.

**Mobile Application Delivery and Technology**

* Guide the development and enhancement of iOS and Android applications.
* Work closely with UX/UI designers, developers, architects, QA, DevOps, and backend engineering teams.

**Customer Experience and Product Optimisation**

* Improve digital customer journeys, including discovery, enquiries, onboarding, documentation, payments, service requests, and ongoing engagement.

* Define and monitor KPIs such as adoption, retention, conversion, feature usage, task completion, application reliability, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive product launches, user education, adoption initiatives, and continuous improvement.

**Operations and Partner Management**

* Manage external delivery partners and coordinate internal teams to ensure delivery quality and accountability.
* Monitor service levels, incident resolution, support performance, recurring defects, and root-cause analysis.
* Coordinate incident response, escalations, stakeholder communications, and permanent corrective actions.
* Conduct regular product and service reviews, track risks, and drive resolution of delivery and operational issues.
* Manage technical debt, platform upgrades, security remediation, and ongoing product sustainability.

**Stakeholder and Performance Management**

* Collaborate with business, technology, operations, customer service, and leadership teams.
* Maintain transparent reporting on roadmap progress, delivery milestones, risks, adoption, and realised business value.
* Balance business priorities with customer needs, technical constraints, security requirements, and operational stability.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Proven experience owning large-scale mobile applications from strategy and discovery through development, launch, optimisation, and live operations.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, backlog management, roadmap planning, release governance, and product analytics.
* Working knowledge of React Native, iOS and Android delivery, APIs, backend services, cloud platforms, and enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with technologies such as Java Spring Boot, Node.js, .NET, SQL, AWS or Azure, and headless CMS platforms.
* Understanding of CI/CD, application security, automated testing, monitoring, crash analytics, and production support.
* Experience managing offshore teams or managed-service partners, including delivery milestones, SLAs, KPIs, and service reviews.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in UAE or GCC real-estate markets.
* Experience with Firebase, New Relic, AWS CloudWatch, enterprise CRM/ERP platforms, and mobile analytics.
* CSPO, PSPO, SAFe POPM, or equivalent product ownership certification.
* Postgraduate qualification or relevant UX, analytics, or customer experience certification.
* Familiarity with ITIL, incident management, problem management, and change and release management.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, commercially minded, technically proficient, and comfortable leading multidisciplinary teams and external partners. They should demonstrate strong ownership, structured problem-solving, sound prioritisation, and the ability to deliver measurable outcomes while maintaining product quality and operational stability.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

**Job descriptions may display in multiple languages based on your language selection.**
**What We Offer**
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
  
  
**Group Summary**
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
Magna is looking for Technical Product owner who collaborates with stakeholders to scale smart solutions driving the development of the vision and mission of the product roadmap. The product owner will be responsible for prioritization and implementation of the features of the product at a scale.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain the Scrum Team Backlog (planning & prioritizing).
* Responsible for the internal stakeholder and customer communication for the assigned scrum team/product.
* Define the team's specific objectives for the upcoming Sprint/Program Increment.
* Coordinate content dependencies with all relevant stakeholders.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.
* Support evaluation of off-the-shelf products to ensure they meet business needs.
* Create contractual project related documentation like a requirements specification and statement of work
* Act with honesty and integrity and make ethical business choices in accordance with Magna’s Compliance Policies and Procedures
* Coordinate with divisional I4.0 champions to ensure deliverables are met based on the business roadmap

**KNOWLEDGE AND EDUCATION**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering discipline (mechanical, electrical, systems, computer science, software, computer or related field of study)
* Minimum of 4-5 years of experience in an Agile environment for a product successfully industrialized
* Proven experience as a Technical Product Owner in a cross-functional team, dedicated to the complete product development lifecycle of successfully launched enterprise solutions deployed globally
* Possesses good communication skills
* Experience with SDLC tools such as JIRA
* Experience capturing and managing software requirements as User Stories
* Experience facilitating backlog refinement
* Experience with user-defined workflows
* Proficient with Microsoft Office applications, specifically Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Should have basic knowledge of software development and the industry for the particular component

**Skills And Competencies**

* Problem solver that is action-oriented with the ability to look at problems in new ways.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability to design an effective solution.
* Ability to support multiple on-going projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication skills, organizational skills, negotiation skills, and flexibility to address competing demands.
* Ability to explain Production / technical concepts and analysis implications clearly to a wide audience and be able to translate business objectives into actionable analyses.
* 2-3 years of Product Owner or Team Lead experience

**Awareness, Unity, Empowerment**
At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.
  
  
**AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure**
As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.
  
  
**Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making.**
If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
  
  
**Worker Type**
Regular / Permanent
  
  
**Group**
Magna Corporate

jobs.title: Product Owner II
jobs.description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Product Analyst role will drive growth and innovation in Experity’s product portfolio. Serving today’s end users while meeting the expanding needs of our growing client base, this person will work closely with Product Managers, development and engineering teams, and other key stakeholders. This role will serve as the subject matter expert between product and engineering to ensure the features brought to life in Experity products align with the company vision, market needs, and deliver technologies that improve the healthcare industry. The Product Analyst will collaborate and align with their manager peers to ensure that the persona(s) and journey effectively represents the interactions and hand-offs between each step.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for product enhancements.
* Conduct customer-centric, data-driven product discovery, including regularly observing customer interactions (sales, install, service, support) and conducting customer interviews.
* Manage risk in new product efforts through value, usability, feasibility, and business testing, measuring and reporting results.
* Contribute to the creation of and update/maintain user personas.
* Contribute to the creation of and update/maintain the journey map as the product(s) evolve.
* Work closely with product manager, users, and internal stakeholders to ensure features are the best possible market fit.
* Create and author items in the engineering tracking system in the required formats (such as Gherkin) in the smallest consumable amount of work, ensuring they contain clear acceptance criteria.
* Create and manage the engineering backlog and sprint plans for your scrum team in concert with the overall product strategy.
* Maintain and ensure target process features are up to date with rollout plans, including feature gates, beta customers, and rollout type.
* Ensure each release has a feature for rollout at beta and production and stories written to enable clients accordingly.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams of product managers, designers, engineers, and product quality to ensure delivery against the product roadmap.
* Drive transparency to backlog details, progress, roadblocks, and other key metrics (across partners, Agile teams, senior leadership, etc.).
* Participate in support/Kanban standups, as needed.
* Represent your product in formal executive settings and reviews.
* Partner with the go-to-market team to prepare operations, marketing, sales, account management, and support product channels for launch.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Product Design, Business or a related field or equivalent combination of education and experience
* Two years of progressive product owner/management experience in healthcare technology or clinical imaging solutions.
* PACS, RIS, imaging workflow products, or similar imaging informatics solutions experience preferred.

**Experience**

* Two years of product owner experience.
* Experience in defining and delivering a roadmap of features that improve NPS and top-line revenue.
* Demonstrated commitment to excellence in yourself and your teams.
* Experience conducting and analyzing customer and product discovery efforts (e.g. interviews, usability tests).
* Strong relationships with your past engineering & design counterparts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication across levels of the organization.
* Demonstrated experience driving ambiguous issues to resolution.
* Demonstrated ability to multitask and manage priorities, including multiple products.

**Preferred**

* Understanding of product KPIs.
* Experience with Scrum and Scrum software tools.
* Prior experience in healthcare technology.

**Team Member Competencies**

* Demonstrate and support the organization's core values.
* Give honest and constructive feedback to other team members.
* Maintains a positive attitude. Tackle challenges as they come, and don’t let setbacks get you down.
* Provide assistance, information, or other support to others to build or maintain relationships.
* Take responsibility for your mistakes and look for solutions. Understand how your actions impact the team.
* Understands role on the team and works to achieve goals to the best of your ability.
* When recognizing a problem, take action to solve it.
* Working within a team means there will be varying opinions and ideas. Active listening and thoughtfully responding to what your team member says.

**Every Team Member Exhibits Our Core Values**

* Team First
* Lift Others Up
* Share Openly
* Set and Crush Goals
* Delight the Client

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Tax Reporting
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
  
  
Product Owner/ Business Analyst – Tax Reporting
  
  
Experience: 3 to 6 Years Job Requisition: TBD
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re seeking a Business Analyst / Product Owner with strong expertise in U.S. tax reporting and securities processing. You’ll act as the bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams, ensuring our products meet complex IRS requirements while driving operational efficiency for global clients. This role combines product ownership, business analysis, and Agile/Scrum leadership to deliver impactful financial solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Product Ownership
  
  
Define and prioritize product backlog items with a focus on IRS/regulatory compliance (cost basis, income reclassification, tax form production).
  
  
Act as Product Owner in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and alignment with business goals.
  
  
Agile & Scrum Delivery
  
  
Collaborate with Scrum Masters and development teams to drive sprint planning, backlog refinement, and timely delivery.
  
  
Champion Agile practices, fostering transparency, adaptability, and continuous improvement across teams.
  
  
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  
Partner with Development, QA teams across geographies to deliver scalable, compliant solutions.
  
  
Facilitate workshops, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to align stakeholders and ensure shared understanding of product goals.
  
  
Client Engagement
  
  
Work directly with clients and partners to capture reporting needs, regulatory changes, and operational challenges.
  
  
Translate complex tax and securities requirements into actionable user stories and product features.
  
  
Domain Expertise
  
  
Apply deep knowledge of IRS/regulatory practices, withholding, corporate actions, and back-office operations.
  
  
Ensure solutions meet tax reporting/regulatory standards with accuracy, reliability, and audit readiness.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Hands-on industry experience in U.S. Tax Reporting and Securities Processing.
  
  
Strong knowledge of IRS requirements for cost basis, income, withholding, and form production.
  
  
**Experience With Back-office Platforms (BPS, BETA Preferred).**
Demonstrated success working in Agile/Scrum environments as a Product Owner or Business Analyst.
  
  
Technical expertise in SQL, PostgreSQL, and Power BI for advanced data analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  
  
Strong communication abilities, adept at engaging with clients and stakeholders.
  
  
Education: BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent.
  
  
Flexibility to work in rotational shifts when required.
  
  
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
  
  
**Use of AI in Hiring**
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

jobs.description:

If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
As a Digital Product Owner for Product Compliance area, you will be involved in development and maintenance of products to manage Part (chemical composition & hazardous info) & Chemical Compliance (Chemical properties & human safety) information for AB Volvo product compliance needs. Your responsibility is to identify and define the solutions that will maximize the value delivered to stakeholders. All work is done in agile teams in iterative collaboration with developers. You are expected to contribute and act as role model in all activities required to achieve customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a candidate with passion, you will work closely with business representatives, product managers, architects, engineers, and operations to ensure that our platforms deliver measurable value and are ready for use in production. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Product Strategy: Define and evolve the product vision, roadmap, objectives, and success measures, aligned with business priorities.
* Business Value & Prioritization: Identify and prioritize business needs for reusable Agentic AI capabilities, balancing customer value, risks, technical dependencies, and capacity.
* Backlog Ownership: Own and refine the team backlog, ensuring clear priorities, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and expected outcomes.
* Cross-Business Reusability: Promote the reuse of Agentic AI capabilities across business areas while accommodating justified business-specific needs.

* Agile Ways of Working: Experience with SAFe, Scrum, backlog management, and Agile product delivery. SAFe or PSPO certification is an advantage.
* Technical Understanding: Working knowledge of cloud platforms (preferably Azure), APIs, system integration, AI security, data privacy, and responsible AI principles.

**Personal attributes**

* Composed, able to stay calm and poised in stressful, difficult, or ambiguous situations.
* Affiliative, with preference for aligning with a larger team or organization working towards a common goal.
* Sociable, with natural inclination to engage with and seek interaction with others.

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join

We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Product-Tech, Central
jobs.description:
**About The/Nudge Institute**
**The/Nudge**
is an action institute building resilient livelihoods to alleviate poverty. We work with women, farmers, tribals, and youth across rural development, agriculture, skilling, and economic inclusion, in partnership with 15+ central and state governments.
  
  
Our economic inclusion journey towards serving 25 million Indians spans 10 states and currently reaches over 1.5 million people. Through our incubator, accelerator, and grand challenges, we have supported 200+ social entrepreneurs, including Forbes 30 Under 30 honorees, Earthshot Prize winners, and nationally recognized changemakers.
  
  
Founded with the support of 130+ eminent philanthropists, 40+ corporates, and 15+ foundations, The/Nudge is working towards a poverty-free India, within our lifetime.
  
  
**About This Role**
The/Nudge is building its own technology products to run the organisation better and to deliver programmes at scale. These include internal platforms our 400+ team members use day to day, and tools that support our programme and field teams. We build fast and in-house, using AI-assisted development tools and LLMs.
  
  
We are looking for an Associate Product Manager to own products end to end: from understanding what users need, to shaping the solution, shipping it, and driving adoption. You will work closely with leadership, programme teams, strategy and operations teams, and with the engineers who build our products. This role suits someone who wants hands-on product ownership early in their career, in an organisation where technology directly serves social impact.
  
  
**What will you do?**

* Discover the problem: Work with internal teams and end users to understand their workflows and pain points through interviews, observation, feedback and usage data. Turn what you learn into clear problem statements.
* Define the product: Write product requirement documents (PRDs), user stories and acceptance criteria. Make sure every feature has a clear purpose, scope and measure of success.
* Prioritise the roadmap: Maintain the product backlog and roadmap. Weigh user impact, effort, risk and organisational priorities, and explain trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.
* Build with engineering and AI: Work hands-on with developers, interns and AI-assisted development tools to design, build and iterate on features. Translate requirements into precise, well-scoped instructions.
* Test before release: Plan and run user acceptance testing, coordinate beta testers, and track bugs and fixes through to closure. Protect live products from regressions.
* Launch and drive adoption: Plan rollouts, write launch communications, run demos and training sessions, and create user guides so that products are actually used.
* Measure what matters: Define and track product metrics such as adoption, usage and user satisfaction. Use the data to decide what to build, fix or retire next.
* Keep things documented: Maintain product documentation, decision logs and release notes so the products can scale and be handed over smoothly.
* Grow the product practice: Help bring a product-first, AI-first way of working to new initiatives as The/Nudge builds more products in the future.

**Who are we looking for in this role?**

* A degree in engineering, computer science, business, economics or a related field. Strong candidates from other backgrounds who can show product thinking are welcome to apply.
* 5+ years of overall experience in product management, business analysis, consulting, technology implementation or software engineering. Experience shipping a product or feature that real users adopted is a strong plus.
* Clear structured thinking: the ability to break a messy problem into its parts and write it up crisply.
* Comfort with data: spreadsheets are a must; basic SQL or a dashboarding tool is a strong plus.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and large language models (LLMs), and curiosity about how they can be used to build products faster.
* Enough technical understanding to work confidently with engineers: how web apps, databases and APIs fit together. You do not need to be a developer.
* Excellent communication with non-technical users, from senior leadership to field teams. You can explain a feature simply and listen well to feedback.
* An ownership mindset: you follow a feature through to adoption, not just to release.
* A strong alignment with our mission to leverage technology for large-scale social impact.

**Good To Have**

* Experience building with no-code, low-code or AI-assisted development tools.
* Exposure to internal tools, ERP, CRM or HRMS systems.
* Experience in the social sector, or working with government or field programmes.

***Please note:***
This is an onsite, full-time role based in our Bengaluru office. We are dedicated to building a dynamic in-office culture and require all team members to work from the office.
  
  
*We aspire to be an inclusive and diverse organisation and encourage qualified individuals irrespective of their religion, caste, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, or any other dimension of identity, to apply.*
