jobs.title: Hybrid Scrum Master & Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Why We Stand Out**
Seeking a new challenge where your professional and personal aspirations are not only possible but supported? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you!
  
  
Kaufman Rossin Professional Services Private Limited's (the "Company") offices are located in the World Trade Center (WTC) in Bangalore, Karnataka, India, and at Udyog Vihar, in Gurgaon, Haryana, India.
  
  
The Bangalore office provides a range of services, including risk management, corporate governance, tax, assurance, and family office services. Out of the Gurgaon office, we render highly specialized back-office alternative investment services for global hedge funds and related fund types. As one of the top accounting firms in the US, our foundation is "people first". In the words of James Kaufman, one of our founders, "We prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day."
  
  
Kaufman Rossin, headquartered in Miami, Florida has been celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida more than a dozen times. The firm has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area and sister entities, Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
  
  
The Firm is ranked 49th among the top 100 firms in the US by Inside Public Accounting 2023. Internationally, the Firm has offices in Bangalore and Haryana in India and the Ivory Coast in Africa.
  
  
**Think you have what it takes?**
This is a single blended position based in Bengaluru within Kaufman Rossin's internal Information Technology department. One person owns both Scrum Master and Product Owner/Business Analyst functions for internal IT initiatives. The role partners directly with US-based IT stakeholders as an equal contributor, proactively driving requirements conversations and jointly defining solutions while facilitating agile ceremonies and coaching the Bengaluru delivery team.
  
  
**Requirements**
**How You'll Contribute:**
**Product Owner Responsibilities**

* Own and maintain the internal IT product backlog, ensuring every Epic, Feature, Story, and Task is well-defined, prioritized, and sprint-ready
* Own the work-item hierarchy: Epics to Features to user stories to tasks, with clear acceptance criteria.
* Partner with US-based IT stakeholders as a peer to drive requirements, challenge assumptions, and co-define solutions.
* Lead backlog refinement with the Bengaluru engineering and delivery teams

**Business Analysis Responsibilities**

* Jointly lead discovery and requirements sessions with internal US IT stakeholders, actively driving conversations rather than only documenting them
* Produce BRDs, functional specifications, process-flow diagrams, and acceptance criteria, collaboratively reviewed with US counterparts
* Own requirements traceability so every delivered feature connects to a documented internal business or technology requirement
* Translate complex internal technology, automation, integration, infrastructure, security, and operational workflows into structured user stories

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**

* Facilitate sprint planning, standups, reviews, and retrospectives across internal IT initiatives
* Provide hands-on Jira and Azure DevOps administration, including boards, workflows, hierarchy, sprint setup, automation, and reporting
* Remove impediments, protect sprint integrity, track and report delivery metrics.
* Drive continuous improvement and coach the Bengaluru team on agile principles and self-organization

**Stakeholder Partnership**

* Engage US IT leaders, internal product owners, technical leads, and business-system stakeholders as a peer; proactively initiate requirements conversations and propose solutions.
* Build trusted relationships across internal IT and with the departments supported by IT, developing genuine knowledge of KR's systems and operating environment.
* Prepare and deliver structured status updates, backlog reviews, sprint metrics, and requirement walkthroughs for US audiences.
* Coordinate across internal IT workstreams while maintaining clear ownership, priorities, dependencies, and escalation paths

**What Skills You'll Bring:**

* 4+ years of Scrum Master, Product Owner, and/or Business Analyst experience in agile delivery, including 2+ years in a blended or dual-capacity role.
* SAFe certification - SAFe Agilist, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, or SAFe Scrum Master - is mandatory.
* Hands-on Jira and Azure DevOps experience, including board configuration, work-item hierarchy, sprint setup, workflow automation, and reporting.
* Proven business-analysis skills in process mapping, requirements traceability, use-case documentation, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder facilitation.
* Experience working with distributed delivery teams and stakeholders across US and India time zones.
* Excellent written and spoken English for stakeholder communication, technical documentation, presentations, and vendor interactions

**Success In the Role**
Success means establishing a reliable, transparent delivery structure for internal IT: a prioritized and sprint-ready backlog, well-run agile ceremonies, traceable requirements, clear delivery metrics, timely escalation of impediments, and trusted working relationships between US stakeholders and the Bengaluru delivery team
  
  
**Benefits**

* Work-Life Balance
* People First Company
* Hybrid work policy
* Working directly with peers in the US

***We embrace authenticity.***
*Kaufman Rossin is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a culture that reflects the diversity of our firm and clients. We encourage understanding, acceptance, and celebration among all people. That includes lifestyle, education, experience, race, ethnicity, age, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, and gender identity.*

jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

jobs.title: Product Owner, Workday, Talent & Performance
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
The
**Experienced Product Owner**
is an experienced, functionally deep Workday professional who owns one or more Workday modules end-to-end on behalf of Revantage and its PortCos. This is not a passive coordination role — it is an active, hands-on domain mastery role. You are the subject-matter expert, the decision-maker, the stakeholder champion, and the product strategist for your assigned module(s). You will work across a complex multi-PortCo environment, running user forums, managing the release roadmap, driving adoption, and continuously finding ways to extract more value from the platform. This role focuses on the Talent & Performance Module. Additional module expertise is a plus.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities
  
  
Domain Ownership & Functional Mastery**

* Own your assigned Workday module(s): Talent & Performance end-to-end — from strategy and design through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing optimization.
* Develop and maintain deep functional expertise in your domain(s), staying current with Workday product updates, roadmap changes, and community best practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and escalation resource for your module area across all PortCos.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of how your module(s) interact with upstream and downstream systems and processes — and design solutions with those dependencies in mind.
* Think beyond Workday: identify complementary or supplementary technologies that could enhance capability in your domain — whether that is AI-powered tools, third-party integrations, or adjacent platforms.

**PortCo Engagement & Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with HR leaders, operations teams, and business stakeholders across multiple PortCos.
* Act as a trusted advisor — understanding each PortCo's unique workforce model, business context, and HR priorities.
* Run structured Product Owner forums, working groups, and user communities to surface requirements, share updates, and drive alignment.
* Manage competing priorities across PortCos with transparency — communicating trade-offs, timelines, and decisions clearly to all stakeholders.
* Facilitate requirements workshops and design sessions, translating business needs into clear, actionable Workday solutions.

**Roadmap & Release Ownership**

* Own and maintain the product roadmap for your module(s) — balancing strategic enhancements, PortCo-driven requirements, bug fixes, and Workday release adoption.
* Evaluate every Workday bi-annual release for impact and opportunity within your domain — leading opt-in decisions, testing, and rollout planning.
* Prioritize the backlog in collaboration with stakeholders, the Functional Architect, and People Technology leadership.
* Ensure all enhancements are delivered with appropriate change management, training, and communications to end users and HR teams.
* Track and report on the delivery and benefit realization of roadmap initiatives.

**Hands-On Delivery**

* Remain hands-on with Workday configuration in your module area — able to configure, test, validate and deploy.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) for enhancements and releases within your domain.
* Create design documents, configuration specifications, and test plans before deployment.
* Own day-to-day delivery.

**Ecosystem & Innovation Thinking**

* Continuously evaluate the HR technology landscape for innovations relevant to your module area — e.g., AI in recruiting, manager effectiveness tools, payroll analytics.
* Propose and build the business case for technology enhancements or new tool adoption where Workday alone does not fully meet business needs.
* Collaborate with vendors (Workday, Paradox, HiredScore, Peakon, etc.) to stay ahead of product developments and advocate for Revantage's priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Workday functional experience with deep, hands-on expertise in at least two Workday modules.
* Demonstrated experience owning a Workday module in a production environment — including enhancements, releases, stakeholder management, and roadmap ownership.
* Nice to have experience working in a multi-entity, multi-PortCo, or shared-services HR technology model.
* Strong understanding of Workday business process configuration, security roles, reporting, and calculated fields.
* Proven ability to engage and influence senior HR stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience running forums, steering committees, or user communities across a distributed stakeholder base.
* Global Workday implementation or support experience — able to navigate multi-jurisdiction complexity.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for business audiences and vice versa.

**Module-specific Experience (by Role):**
Talent & Learning: Performance reviews, goal management, succession planning, learning campaigns, content management, and skills framework.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Pro certification in one or more relevant modules.
* Experience with third-party HR technology integrations and vendor management.
* Exposure to change management methodologies and communication planning.
* Prior experience in private equity, financial services, or multi-company real estate environments.
* Familiarity with Agile or product management frameworks (backlog management, sprint planning, road mapping tools).

**About Revantage**
Revantage is a Blackstone portfolio company and a leading provider of corporate services across Blackstone's Real Estate portfolio. Headquartered in Chicago, Revantage supports a diverse and complex ecosystem of portfolio companies (PortCos) spanning residential, commercial, logistics, hospitality, and life-sciences real estate globally — across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

Oracle’s Global Finance Information Center (GFIC) in Bangalore is a strategic shared-services finance center supporting Oracle Finance. Within GFIC, the Accounts Receivables Center of Excellence manages global invoice-delivery operations and supports Oracle’s response to the evolving global e-invoicing and e-reporting landscape.

**Job Summary**

The **Global E-Invoicing Business Analyst – IC3** will support the design, implementation, and rollout of e-invoicing and e-reporting capabilities across multiple countries.

This role serves as a bridge between country-specific regulatory requirements and the teams responsible for delivering scalable global solutions, including Tax, Finance, IT, Legal/Compliance, local teams, and external e-invoicing service providers.

The Business Analyst will take end-to-end ownership of assigned country requirements—from regulatory discovery and requirements definition through data mapping, testing, go-live, and stabilization—while promoting reuse of global standards and solution components.

**Location:** Bangalore, India
  
**Level:** IC3

  

* **Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze country-specific e-invoicing and e-reporting requirements, including invoice formats, mandatory data elements, validation rules, and submission, clearance, or reporting models.
* Translate regulatory and business requirements into clear functional and system requirements, documenting assumptions, decisions, gaps, dependencies, and required outcomes.
* Map e-invoice requirements to ERP, billing, tax, customer, vendor, and other relevant source-system data; identify gaps and coordinate their resolution.
* Partner with Tax, Finance, Legal/Compliance, IT, local teams, and external service providers to support solution design, integration, and implementation.
* Coordinate end-to-end country rollout activities spanning discovery, design, mapping, testing, readiness assessment, cutover, go-live, and post-go-live stabilization.
* Develop and support test scenarios, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), invoice-data validation, defect resolution, and end-to-end testing across standard and exception scenarios.
* Track implementation milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions, and open issues; provide timely stakeholder updates and escalate blockers appropriately.
* Maintain standardized implementation documentation and promote reuse of global requirements, templates, mappings, and solution components while accommodating legitimate country-specific requirements.

  **Qualifications & Skills**

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and solution-oriented Business Analyst to oversee CRM systems, digital platforms, and IT operations from our Bangalore office. The role involves streamlining business processes, improving system efficiency, analysing data, and providing technology-driven support to sales and back-office teams. Ideal for someone who combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on technical expertise and takes ownership of improving day-to-day business operations.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**1. CRM and Sales Support**

● Manage incoming website and chatbot leads within the CRM, ensuring timely distribution to the sales team.

● Administer the CRM platform, including user accounts, access permissions, security, configurations, feature enhancements, integrated bots, and performance monitoring.

● Coordinate the Bangalore lead-generation team, review lead quality, and ensure approved leads are accurately entered into the CRM.

● Maintain accurate sales pipeline data and validate it before monthly sales reports are prepared.

● Troubleshoot CRM issues and recommend process improvements to raise usability and sales team productivity.

**2. Website, Chatbot and Digital Marketing**

● Maintain the website, including plugin updates, design and content changes, and error troubleshooting; coordinate back-end and database issues with technical support teams or service providers.

● Conduct SEO keyword research, update existing blogs, and develop new content based on keywords and relevant industry topics.

● Manage the company's Facebook page (posts, blogs, greetings) and route social media enquiries to the relevant sales stakeholder.

This role will primarily support Salesforce B2B E-commerce, Salesforce Service Cloud, and related enterprise applications used across E-commerce, Customer Service, and DCS business operations.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong business analyst and solution partner who can understand complex business problems, translate them into scalable technology solutions, and work across multiple systems, stakeholders, and delivery teams. This role requires someone who is not limited to a single platform but can quickly understand business processes, system capabilities, data flows, integrations, and operational dependencies.
  
  
This person will partner with business stakeholders, architects, developers, BSAs, and application owners to define requirements, shape solutions, manage delivery backlogs, and drive business value through process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

jobs.description:
**Surya at a Glance**
Surya was founded in 1999 by Mr. D.N. Prahlad (an early employee of Infosys), to create software products. Headquartered in Bangalore, we also have offices in the USA, and France.
  
  
Surya Financial Technologies Private Limited (Surya), has been leading the Financial Control & Risk Management solution space with 25+ years of experience in developing and implementing Risk Management and Balance Sheet Management Solutions at 75+ BFSI customers globally. Surya has invested heavily in the research & development in the ever-evolving Financial Risk landscape and has been at the forefront of providing solutions that not just meet the guidelines and requirements for today but also supporting the institutions with future ready investments.
  
  
Surya, being a global player, has a strong clientele spreading across South Asia, Middle East, Africa and North America. In the span of 25+ years, Surya has addressed and successfully implemented Financial Risk Transformation projects, working with marquee clients with an Asset Base of USD 450 Bn+ to less than USD 500 Mn, across the spectrum of financial services industry.
  
  
At Surya, we believe that high quality leads to high productivity. We offer the right balance of technical excellence in software engineering and deep knowledge of risk management. Our core values are focused on simplicity, superior functional architecture, advanced technology, quick deployment, and ease of maintenance. We ensure high levels of efficiency and lower total cost of ownership (TCO) for our clients. We understand that an organization’s risk and reporting requirements are growing more sophisticated every year with evolving and new regulations, expansion into new markets, and competitive pressures. Adopting Innovation in technology and coming up with world class solutions which can be deployed with ease has been the corner stone of Surya’s success globally.
  
  
**Your Growth at Surya**
Surya’s growth is driven by ordinary people who have extraordinary dreams and are bold enough to pursue them. Our leadership team, including our Managing Director, is composed primarily of people who joined Surya as freshers. Through our process of continuous feedback, and regular 1-1 conversations, we believe in upskilling our team, and enabling each of them to grow along paths they find satisfying.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
To lead the implementation and continuous enhancement of Operational Risk and GRC solutions by delivering client engagements, conducting fit-gap analysis, and contributing to product development aligned with regulatory requirements and evolving industry needs.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Execute end-to-end implementation of Operational Risk and GRC solutions, including requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, and system configuration.
* Translate client and regulatory requirements into functional specifications and drive solution design within the product.
* Collaborate with product and technology teams to build, test, and enhance GRC modules based on implementation learnings.
* Support product evolution through continuous feedback, data insights, and alignment with emerging regulatory and market needs.

**Functional Responsibilities**

* Lead requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis by mapping client needs to Operational Risk and GRC frameworks (RCSA, KRI, Loss/Event Management, Issues Management).
* Conduct workshops and training sessions to enable business and support units to adopt GRC tools, risk methodologies, and workflows.
* Translate regulatory guidelines and business requirements into functional specifications, use cases, and process flows.
* Design risk frameworks within the product, including risk taxonomy, control libraries, assessment structures, and reporting hierarchies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders (Risk, Compliance, Audit, Business Units) to validate requirements and ensure alignment with regulatory expectations.
* Support UAT cycles, including test case preparation, execution, and business validation prior to go-live.
* Drive post-implementation adoption by resolving functional issues, refining workflows, and ensuring effective utilization of GRC modules.
* Contribute to product enhancements by identifying gaps and incorporating implementation learnings into functional improvements.

**Technical Responsibilities**

* Configure and deploy GRC/ORMS platforms, including workflows, forms, rules, and role-based access controls.
* Implement and customize modules such as RCSA, KRI, Risk Events/Loss Data, Issue Management, and Dashboards/Reporting.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to translate functional requirements into technical designs, APIs, and system integrations.
* Support data migration, system integration, and validation to ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms.
* Build and enhance dashboards and reports using data analytics tools to enable risk monitoring and decision-making.
* Manage system performance, troubleshoot issues, and coordinate with technical support teams for bug fixes and enhancements.
* Ensure system readiness for audits and regulatory reviews through proper data capture, audit trails, and reporting capabilities.

**Description**

**Job Description: Business Analyst – Revenue & Operations**

**About Apna**

Founded in 2019, Apna is one of India’s leading professional networking platforms, dedicated to empowering the country’s workforce with employment, professional networking, and skilling opportunities. Operating across 60+ cities in 20+ states, Apna is backed by marquee investors, including Tiger Global, Lightspeed, Sequoia, Owl Ventures, and Greenoaks Capital.

With over 16 million users and 100,000+ employers on the platform, Apna is committed to enabling livelihoods for billions of people across India.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a data-driven and analytical Business Analyst – Revenue & Operations to join our Operations team. In this role, you will work closely with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, Support, Marketing, and Account Management teams to drive operational efficiency, improve sales performance, and enable data-driven decision-making.

You will be responsible for analyzing business and operational data, developing dashboards, optimizing SQL queries and data pipelines, monitoring lead distribution and sales performance, and identifying opportunities to improve customer acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong SQL and analytical skills with a solid understanding of CRM systems, sales operations, and customer lifecycle management.

**Requirements**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Analysis & Business Insights**

* Collect, analyze, and interpret business, sales, and operational data to identify trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities.
* Generate actionable insights to improve operational efficiency, sales productivity, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance.
* Analyze customer lifecycle data to identify opportunities for cross-selling, upselling, retention, and churn prevention.
* Track key business metrics, including conversion rates, pipeline performance, customer acquisition, and retention.

**2. SQL, Data Pipelines & Reporting**

* Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Build and maintain data pipelines to ensure accurate, reliable, and timely availability of business data.
* Support ETL processes and ensure data consistency across reporting systems.
* Identify data discrepancies, investigate root causes, and implement improvements to data quality and reporting accuracy.

**3. Dashboard Development & Performance Tracking**

* Build and maintain dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) across Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, and Support operations.

* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for business leaders and stakeholders.

**4. CRM & Lead Management**

* Monitor CRM data quality, completeness, and accuracy to support effective sales execution and account management.
* Analyze and improve lead-routing, lead-assignment, and distribution processes across multiple sales channels.
* Ensure leads are assigned to the appropriate teams based on business rules, sales segments, and account ownership.
* Identify gaps in CRM workflows and recommend process improvements to prevent lead leakage, duplication, and misallocation.

**5. Revenue Operations & Process Optimization**

* Collaborate with Inside Sales, Field Sales, Enterprise Sales, Marketing, Support, and Account Management teams to streamline business processes.
* Establish and monitor reporting frameworks to distinguish new customer acquisition from existing customer account management.
* Analyze revenue-related metrics, including conversion rates, pipeline velocity, customer acquisition cost (CAC), retention, and win/loss trends, wherever applicable.
* Partner with stakeholders to define business metrics, standardize reporting, and implement data-backed process improvements.
* Support business reviews, ad hoc analysis, and strategic initiatives through timely and accurate data insights.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Operations Analyst, Sales Operations Analyst, or Revenue Operations Analyst.
* **Strong proficiency in SQL**
  , including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data manipulation, and query optimization.
* Hands-on experience with data extraction, transformation, reporting, and preferably building or maintaining data pipelines.
* Experience in creating dashboards and reports using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar tools.
* Understanding of sales funnels, lead management, revenue reporting, customer lifecycle analytics, and operational KPIs.
* Ability to translate business requirements into meaningful reports, dashboards, and actionable recommendations.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present insights to non-technical teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in a B2B, SaaS, technology, or high-growth startup environment.
* Exposure to multiple sales channels, including Inbound, Inside Sales, Field Sales, and Enterprise Sales.
